answer: Each epoch publishes a signal; a new identity must finish a sequential delay puzzle seeded by that signal before its bond is accepted: 20 minutes of single-core work, unshortenable by cores. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 core-minutes plus 60 credits each, 60,000 against a 40,000-credit pool. A summit of 40 admissions per epoch means a gale of fakes wastes its bonds. Proofs bind to their keys, so rented proofs fail. Honest agents pay once.
